title: Gift unified author module: business, computation and product source (design candidate)
description: One proposed structured author language; 27 candidate Definition kinds. Shape acceptance never implies interpreted meaning, method availability, authorization or target implementation.

imports.description: Optional explicit imports for non-prelude definitions. local is the self alias; std is the frozen pure primitive semantic domain of this Author Writer and cannot be rebound to a user module, library, dynamic Provider or Target alias. Every other imported alias must have a qualified moduleId and a binding/lock.

definitions.description: Local definitions may be empty only for an export-only facade. Semantic linking verifies that each export resolves to an exact, public imported symbol; source modules do not gain new identities or authorities.

additionalProperties.description: A stable public name routes either to a local Definition or to a public symbol of an explicit import; no implicit wrapper function or extra authority.

MemberName.description: Record field and variant case name, shared by declarations, construction, access and matching. Definition and binder names retain Identifier.

mutable.description: Omitted or false means an immutable field. true selects the common managed Place semantics: aliases and shallow reconstruction preserve the Place; a real new construction creates a new Place. This shape does not grant write or ownership permission.

optional.description: Omitted or false means required. true records independent Absent/Present(T) state; it does not replace payload T by Option<T>. Record meaning and qualification are owned by the common computation contract.

Effect.description: Recoverable raise carries its exact error upper-bound Type only in a selected managed abortive-error profile. All function, lambda and higher-order signatures use this same effect. The semantic checker validates error identity, admissible payload ownership/lifetime, closed error-family mappings and method/Target support; shape alone grants no execution or catch-all capability. Non-raise effects cannot carry errorType. Old readers must reject unsupported revisions rather than erase raise.

roleBindings.description: Optional explicit role occurrence bindings. Existing goal-scoped exact actor/object bindings remain untouched; conflicting overrides must be rejected by semantic qualification.

bits.description: Author JSON numeric control field is bounded to interoperable safe integer precision; larger exact quantities require an explicitly different lossless type/profile, never a rounded JSON number.

scale.description: Author JSON numeric control field is bounded to interoperable safe integer precision; larger exact quantities require an explicitly different lossless type/profile, never a rounded JSON number.

open.description: Omitted or false is closed. true preserves a complete typed remainder; it never discards extra fields or gives Any payloads. Record domain, row witnesses, ownership and visibility remain semantic checks.

rowType.description: The explicit remainder type must resolve to a qualified record Type and preserve the same row parameter/witness; it is legal only with explicit open:true. Shape validation does not prove Record/Lacks or nominal qualification.

effects.description: Legacy complete Effect[] remains accepted unchanged as a closed row; the common row form adds a qualified EffectRow tail. All original effect fields including recoverable raise.errorType remain authoritative. Function type, declaration and lambda omission defaults stay distinct in the semantic owner.

typeParams.description: Existing restricted callback-local binders only: Region/Scope and argument binding. Omission in a function type is no local binders; a lambda may inherit the unique expected signature. Reading the type does not create a fresh runtime witness.

callMode.description: Existing function invocation qualification; distinct from Param.mode. Omission retains the original profile rule and grants no new ownership or execution permission.

oneOf.description: Existing common type application in successor encoding. Only a constructor whose remaining result is Type is legal; finite expand and actual kind/phase/constraint checks use the original common parameter owner.

Int/UInt literals use canonical exact decimal strings. Decimal uses exact signed integer coefficient and bounded nonnegative base-10 scale. Bool/Text/Unit use their matching JSON boolean/string/null representations. Never has no inhabitant and cannot be a literal; this selected profile does not offer an implicit Float JSON-number literal—use the bound F64Bits/decodeF64 or a qualified numeric constructor. Other nominal/specialized values still require their actual Type/Value codec; mere JSON shape is not semantic qualification. Bytes literals additionally require an explicit codec in scalar Type.encoding (hex/base64/utf8) and a string representation. Canonical lowercase even-length hex is checked by schema; base64 canonicality and UTF-8 scalar decoding are checked by the qualified codec. No silent implicit encoding, locale normalization or JSON numeric array conversion.

body.description: In the selected common text profile, pure expression lambdas keep '(args) => Expr'. A structured lexical ExecBlock body has the distinct, unambiguous source form '(args) => scope { statements [result] }'. 'scope' is contextual; it does not make a new global keyword or rewrite legacy lambdas. Body return/break/capture/effect is checked using the same lexical function boundary.

semanticArguments.description: The existing common call static-argument slot: a present array completely covers argument binders in declaration order; fresh slots are not supplied. Whole omission requests only unique inference. Values are normalized in the fixed static phase, never from not-yet-evaluated runtime arguments.

fields.description: Ordered field initializers: evaluate each value exactly once in array order, stopping on a non-normal exit. Names must be unique under the semantic record check; whole-item uniqueItems would not enforce that rule. Type.record.fields remains an unordered declaration map. Never infer execution order from JSON object member order.

oneOf.description: Ordered eval of each step, then result, in the existing lexical/control context. Derived ExecBlock analysis only; no new function boundary, implicit Result bind, or hidden error conversion. Existing flow, ownership and cleanup rules apply.

arguments.description: One expression is the entire exact PortOperation.input value. Empty is permitted semantically only when the resolved input is Unit; no implicit record/tuple packing. The type consumer checks this condition.

oneOf.description: Invoke one exactly bound operation after evaluating its complete input once and obtaining actual call admission. Normal expression type is Result<output,errors>, including nested Result and Never errors; Fault, Cancel and unsettled or unknown outcomes keep their existing call channels. A declaration is never a live Grant.

Expr.description: Tagged computation expressions. symbol references local/imported bindings or exactly the finite reserved std symbols frozen by docs/领域/计算基础/文法类型与求值.md#successor-structured-std-int-add. That owner defines each symbol's signature, arity, type instantiation, value domain, error interpretation and Method/Target qualification; the IntAdd same-Type integer family is not generalized to Bool, Sequence, Text or other arithmetic. Unlisted std names are unsupported. This schema does not supply implementations or grant semantic qualification merely by accepting a symbol or Type tag.

targets.description: Multiple concurrent compatible targets for one transition. Cannot coexist with to. If both are omitted the transition has no target and only performs its declared abstract actions.

kind.description: External is the target-bearing default; internal is used for targetless or qualified in-scope descendant transitions. State owner defines domain and exit/entry differences.

StateTransition.description: A transition references the active source state and optionally an external event. A targetless transition is internal, never a silent exit-reentry. Explicit external requires a target. Source ancestry, region conflicts and eventless stabilization are interpreted by the state semantic owner, not by JSON object presence.

WorkflowStep.description: One discriminated workflow step with exactly one kind-specific vocabulary. needs expresses data readiness, not control transfer; all explicit branches and result uses resolve within this workflow invocation. No implicit array-order execution, missing mandatory effects, or mixed-kind optional fields. The professional Workflow owner defines control, failures, cancellation, timeout and unknown outcomes.

actionRef.description: Refers to a domain:meaning of category operation or event, describing an intended UI action, NEVER directly to an effect:port, Workflow or Method. It does not dispatch itself. A component-local activationRoutes edge identifies the controlled UI occurrence and target workflow. Meaning role/authority, data mapping and UI Runtime remain Needs until qualified.

TypeParam.description: Existing name and constraintRefs are retained. Omitted kind is Type and omitted binding is argument. fresh is limited to Region/Scope at a method-qualified real introduction; callback-local binders follow the original restricted rule. keyFields.description: Ordered composite key columns, each declared exactly once. Semantic consumer verifies column existence, compatible non-null/equality constraints, source uniqueness, target index/order and migration; Schema cannot certify the actual key constraint.

rowIdentity.description: Explicit relation with no stable per-row key. Physical row location, value hash, and position do not create durable identity.

rowMultiplicity.description: Keyless set deduplicates under qualified value equality; bag preserves repeated row occurrences. Neither permits implicit writes or order.

Entity.description: Stable keyed entity and explicitly keyless set/bag relation are distinct author meanings. A keyless row cannot be individually edited without independent stable locator, qualified preimage, transaction and authority.

termId.description: Stable term identity within one quality contract for explicitly ranked/weighted comparisons; not a global metric or real-world measurement ID.

objective.description: Unbounded soft objective in this metric; does not require a fabricated threshold.

priority.description: Explicit lexicographic priority of a soft term; smaller number first. Semantic linker rejects duplicate priorities and does not infer them from array position. Soft clauses are either a threshold preference with relation or a directional objective with no invented threshold. Score/priority/weight are qualified under the enclosing comparisonPolicy; syntax never certifies measurement quality.

bindings.description: Omitted means the empty role binding map. If referenced declaration has required context roles, omission remains a missing binding (not a default object). An explicit empty object has identical semantics.

DefinitionUse.description: A noncomputational occurrence of a reusable typed Definition, with actual role bindings; does not invoke a function or imply its implementation. useId names the occurrence only in its containing product:component or product:system, not in the workspace/global namespace.

PublicEndpoint.description: A named externally visible product interface, supplied by one particular product component instance; visibility is not permission or target implementation.

ExternalRequirement.description: One required port is intentionally delegated to an external environment; absent providerRef means demand without supplier. Even a present providerRef still needs authoritative external binding, Grant and target qualification.

StateParticipation.description: Hosting a state-machine lifetime differs from observing an externally hosted state. Neither grants transition authority.

DataAccess.description: Independent logical schema ownership, read or write intention; access/ownership does not issue permissions, storage method or transactional guarantees.

EventParticipation.description: Event producer and subscriber are independently typed; delivery, retention and broker supply remain distinct.

ProtocolParticipation.description: API client and service provider are separate roles; transport and sessions require qualified implementation.

ResourceParticipation.description: Resource ownership, provisioning and consuming are separate from capacity, lease and admission qualification.

UiParticipation.description: One view occurrence with a nonempty set of UI participation capabilities. Multiple roles must not require duplicating its DefinitionUse and accidentally referring to different rendered trees.

ObservationParticipation.description: Observer production, data consumption, and independent assurance/auditing must not be conflated.

StaticValueActual.description: Non-executable static literal for a ComponentParameter whose mode is value. typeRef names a core:type in the occurrence module. Absence, null, collections, units and precision are not interchangeable. The formal contractRef and typed literal must agree; the qualified semantic/type consumer checks actual content, quantity/units/encoding and target support. This field grants no runtime effect and does not evaluate Expr.

ActivationCause.description: An explicit event source in an instance: UI control, subscribed event stream, served API endpoint, hosted state-machine event, or qualified schedule. Different sources have different permission, timing, delivery, and payload contracts; this is a discriminated closed union, not an arbitrary relation.

inputBindings.description: Construct the single workflow input from the frozen cause payload; omitted preserves that exact payload subject to target typing. No workflow step exists yet, so result/outcome are structurally unavailable. Real cause scope, Type, permission and nominal record qualification remain semantic checks.

completionUse.description: Select the existing operation Meaning and qualified Method that connect this source's completion capability to the same workflow Run/Execution. Omission is valid only when the locked source contract uniquely determines the full disposition. Runtime source/Run arguments are not authored object bindings; actual sending, progress, cancellation and settlement retain their original owners.

Loops/reentry cannot choose the latest same-name frame. kind distinguishes succeeded/failed/cancelled/timed-out/unresolved; value/error exist only under the actual producer Type and outcome. ValueSource.description: A closed tagged set of value-origin shapes reused only as a schema helper. Each consumer restricts eligible origins and performs its own type/scope checks. NOT a global AnyValue store or computational language.

ValueBindings.description: Formal parameter or declared approval-role Identifier to a typed value-origin at one qualified call site. Keys resolve to its real signature; omitted/empty map does not inherit a workflow single-value payload. Not used for workflow input/output records or public result projection.

RecordValueBindings.description: MemberName-keyed map reused for operation record inputs, workflow single-value construction and public result projection only at their declared use sites. The owning consumer decides the target Type and omission rule: workflow input/terminal maps resolve actual record fields or the non-record value slot; ordinary step result maps construct a typed record. No callable-parameter grammar, arbitrary value store, implicit field alias or execution authority is created.

inputs.description: Omission is the empty input binding map; admissible only when the declared operation has no required inputs and defaults (if any) are professionally qualified. Explicit {} is semantically identical.

OperationUse.description: Port and *one explicit operation* with typed input slots; qualified permission, effects, error and result types remain owned by interface/effect consumers. inputs keys are field names of the operation input record (direct or resolved nominal); for a scalar input use the reserved key value. Target signature/Method refines this mapping.

UiDataBinding.description: UI data reads are typed source uses. Editing requires a distinct business action and activation route; it cannot directly mutate arbitrary state/effects.

StateNode.description: A structured state graph in the existing state:machine Body, not another StateDefinition kind. String shorthand is an atomic state. All nodes share one local identity namespace; kind controls legal parent/initial/region/fallback/entry/exit use. Valid configuration, transitions, event generation, restoration and external effects are owned by the state/runtime contracts. Compound/region require initial direct child; parallel has region children rather than a single initial. Atomic/final and history pseudo states cannot carry initial; only history carries fallback. Parent ancestry, parallel region uniqueness and transition choice require semantic resolution of the complete chart.

ImportedExport.description: Alias of an explicitly imported public export. Binding and visibility must be checked against the exact imported ModuleUse and lock; no wildcard exports.

ExecBody.description: An expression or finite common lexical control block. Object-specific field writes, parent initialization, object construction/read/dispatch and class declarations are NOT implied by this plain branch; they use an exactly bound object dialect body/consumer, with explicit qualified conversion for the shared subset. Do not reinterpret Expr.field as a mutable object member or Expr.var as privileged this/super.

ExecBlock.description: A lexical block. Statements evaluate in order; result is evaluated iff ordinary completion reaches it. No result means Unit. Return/Break/Continue/Fault/Cancel are distinct exits, never data Result.Err. Local var positions are new per block activation and while iteration.

oneOf.description: Lexical immutable binding; evaluate initializer once, then bind after success.
Lexical mutable location, distinct from Expr.var which only reads a bound name.
Evaluate RHS before writing the nearest valid mutable location. Reject immutable, unbound, inaccessible or moved targets.
Only one branch runs after exactly one Bool condition evaluation; absent else is Unit.
Evaluate Bool condition before every iteration; enter fresh lexical body scope on each true iteration. No arbitrary compile-time iteration bound.
Exit the nearest lexically enclosing while in the current function or lambda. A structural checker must reject outside one.
Continue nearest lexically enclosing while, re-evaluating the condition. Cannot cross a lambda/function boundary.
Exit current function or lambda, not caller; omitted value means Unit. Check return type and cleanup.
Evaluate an expression in sequence and discard an ordinary value; must diagnose unconsumed Result per actual language contract.
Execute a nested lexical block; nested result is discarded as a statement, but effects and abnormal exits propagate.

ExecStatement.description: Exactly the ten common lexical statement shapes, not a complete object-method body. FieldWrite and SuperInit from the object language require its distinct qualified dialect/body codec; unknown object nodes are preserved in their original source rather than converted to generic set/perform.

coefficient.description: Canonical exact integral coefficient, not a host floating JSON number. Zero has coefficient '0', preserving chosen scale separately.

scale.description: Exact base-10 fractional scale. Actual Type.scale compatibility, target precision/rounding and resource budget are checked by the qualified decimal consumer.

DecimalLiteral.description: The exact decimal value coefficient * 10^(-scale), with scale explicitly preserved. No guessed rounding, no JSON float coercion and no implicit physical representation.

ParameterRef.description: Successor-local semantic parameter locator resolved in its actual lexical declaration scope. It is normalized to the same bound parameter identity as the common parameter contract, not a runtime object or global name.

Kind.description: Encoding adapter of the existing common Kind algebra only. Value<T> uses this profile Type and static Expr phase; no FieldKey or Row Kind is introduced.

EffectRow.description: The common effect row in this profile uses the complete existing Effect atom encoding, retaining class, port/resource/scope and raise.errorType. Legacy Effect[] is the closed-row encoding. tail binds an EffectRow parameter; unknown effects are not empty and this record grants no effect authority.

SemanticArgument.description: packElement is shared with TypeTerm; contextual kind checking and qualified phase evaluation are mandatory.

LambdaParam.description: Only lambda-local parameters may omit type, and only when a unique qualified expected callable signature supplies it. An omitted annotation is not Any. Ordinary declaration Param.type remains required; original mode semantics is retained.

ParameterContracts.description: Positions refer to the actual parameter sequence after qualified finite pack expansion. Duplicate positions, range, noescape and body/implementation evidence are checked by the original callable owner.

Captures.description: Potential Region/Scope lifetime dependencies of a real function value. Function type omission is the original empty upper bound; declaration/lambda omission requests analysis. No extra capture or resource registry is created.

PortParameterContracts.description: This PortOperation has one aggregate input formal at position 0. Input record field order does not create callable parameter positions. A different port profile must supply its actual parameter mapping; this non-function-value operation has no captures field.

x-gift-author-qualification: All declared Kind shapes are in the single proposed author design; meaning/compute/method/target qualifications are independent and not assumed from schema recognition.
$comment: Design contract; Schema establishes only serialized syntax. Domain types, scopes, names, totality, environment, grants, semantic effect inference, branch reachability and Target qualifications remain professional owner rules. No implemented compiler or checker is implied.
